period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo/Standalone basis. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2019 (as published in the FY2019 Annual Report's own 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table, pubalibank-annual-report-2019.txt lines 14744-14787, p.238 of the report), not discrete-quarter figures -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, matching CITYBANK's convention. This is a BSEC-mandated corporate-governance disclosure (Corporate Governance Code item 1.5(ix), 'significant variance between Quarterly Financial Performance and Annual Financial Statements'); most banks answer it with only a checkbox, but Pubali Bank publishes a full data table titled 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' giving Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 balance-sheet and cumulative-income figures. All 14 available PUBALIBANK annual reports (FY2011-2024, the only years with extracted text; pubalibangla.com itself is Cloudflare-blocked) were searched for this table: it is present ONLY in the FY2017, FY2018, FY2019 and FY2020 Annual Reports (this is one more year -- FY2017 -- than a prior research pass had flagged, which found only FY2018-2020). Every other year (FY2011-2016, FY2021, FY2022, FY2023 [a 105-line stub with only the Balance Sheet], FY2024) contains only the checkbox-style compliance-item 1.5(ix) answer, confirmed by searching for the table heading, the distinctive phrase 'Committee and by the Board', and the 'Business Segment' table that immediately follows it in every year that does have it -- none of these markers appear in the other 10 years' extracted text. BASIS MATCH CONFIRMED: this table's own Solo-basis figures for Dec-of-year exactly match (to the taka, where a directly-reported comparison is available) PUBALIBANK's main Q4 series, which sources.json determines is Solo/Standalone throughout -- e.g. this table's Dec-2018 Total Assets 409,744,092,267 and Total Shareholders' Equity 27,377,102,911 exactly equal 2018_Q4.json's 409744.09m/27377.10m; Dec-2019 474,355,971,748 exactly equals 2019_Q4.json's 474355.97m. The table's own text ('...Bank has prepared and presented Quarter Ended Financial Statements...', referring only to 'the Bank', not 'the Bank and its subsidiaries') is also consistent with Solo scope, distinct from the Consolidated 'Business Segment' table that immediately follows it in the same report. This table therefore uses the SAME basis (Solo/Standalone) as PUBALIBANK's main series -- no basis mismatch. CROSS-CHECKED against the FY2020 Annual Report's own comparative '2019' column: every balance-sheet and income-statement figure for Jun-19 and Sep-19 matches EXACTLY. Two small discrepancies were found elsewhere in this same cross-check (recorded here for completeness, neither affects this quarter's own figures): (1) Dec-19 (FY2019 Q4, already covered by the existing, untouched 2019_Q4.json -- not re-created here) Other Assets and Total Assets are ~3.72bn (8.8%) HIGHER in the FY2020 report's comparative column than in this (contemporaneous, preferred) FY2019 report, while Total Liabilities is unchanged and Deposits is a smaller ~266m (0.07%) LOWER -- i.e. a Dec-31-2019-specific reclassification/restatement, not present in any Q1-Q3 interim column checked; (2) Mar-19 EPS is 0.74 here vs 0.71 in the FY2020 report's comparative, despite IDENTICAL Net Profit After Tax (734,599,389) in both -- an isolated single-cell discrepancy (implied weighted-average share count differs slightly), kept at this contemporaneous value per project convention.
